description: List SIP symbols. Return all supported SIP symbols. → Returns the complete SIP catalog as {current_page: 1, has_more: false, symbols: [{name: string, code: string, type: string, exchange: string, currency_code: string, country: string, description: string}]}. Use filter to return only relevant rows when you do not need the full catalog. Use a returned SIP: code with get_sip_quotes, get_sip_series, get_sip_history, or get_sip_trades.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

name: list_sip_symbols
